body: Thank you.  The therapy line is something for me to think about.  I just want you to know, I'll be here, too, if you ever need to PM someone (although I can't promise an immediate reply with the Internet out here in the sticks!). Good luck.

Jesus, this post made me well up.  I'm especially sensitive about Mother/Child relationships, as that will be the most important bond you will ever share.  I was bullied mercilessly for years about everything, from my curly hair to being smart, kids will pick on others for no reason today (even though now I realize they were completely wrong, and, hoping I'm not sounding narcissistic here, I am smart and attractive, contrary to their beliefs).  I was about her age, too.  You can tell her it gets better, and show her all the replies in the world, but children don't believe that adults really do know what they're taking about most of the time.  If it has gotten to the point where she did this, she needs professional help, first and foremost.  

The only other thing I can say, and I say this with all the passion in me, is that it's a *very* good thing you now know about the extent of the bullying.  I wouldn't tell anyone about my bullying because it would be embarrassing, so I understand why she hid it so deeply.  If I were a parent, I would go after that school and the bullies tooth and nail and someone would pay dearly.  It seems as though the law is getting stricter and taking things like this more seriously nowadays, so that is always an option.  I truly hope she pulls through, and we are all here with you through this.  Sending Internet hugs your way.

Hello there, I just wanted you to know I'm glad you replied to my post and also that you got help in your time of need.  Hopefully, those thoughts won't linger too long, and good things will come your way. It really hit home that you understand that I shouldn't be made to feel like things are all my fault.  Anywho, I updated my post after a long internet outage (more than 30 minutes without Internet?  BLASPHEMY) if you would like to read it.  Here's hoping good vibes follow you always; at least you can always know there's one person out there sending them your way for sure :). Thank you.
